lookup.budget_semantics: 64 eligible exact-key matches per pass, not 64 raw history positions. Skipped current/ineligible/hash-collision positions do not increment inspected. Up to one selection pass and four length-support passes per key length; each scans newest first.
lookup.raw_positions_examined_hard_cap: No independent raw-position cap in the frozen implementation; bucket traversal can exceed 64.

thresholds.support_rule: No explicit extra support guard; positive support follows rho >= 0.67

lookup.rho_definition: support / eligible for exact equality of all k continuation tokens, zero if no eligible occurrence
lookup.selection: For each key length choose next-token group by max(count, matched context, available continuation, occurrence position); representative occurrence by max(matched context, available continuation, occurrence position). Test only that representative continuation; first qualifying k and first qualifying key length wins.
lookup.collision_handling: Hash bucket candidates must pass exact key-token comparison before being counted.
lookup.indexing: Prompt and target-committed output both use _extend/_append; rejected proposals never indexed; request-local only.
lookup.output_boundary: Only test ladder lengths <= min(8, remaining_output-1); no qualification below 2.
lookup.eos: Lookup implementation does not inspect EOS; generator must enforce target-committed EOS.

beta.note: Paper beta is the new-observation coefficient; do not mislabel the old-value weight 0.7 as beta.

controller_state.ema_rule: First observation sets ema=accepted/total; later ema=0.7*old+0.3*(accepted/total).
controller_state.observation_unit: One RateStat update per draft round; total/n accumulates drafted TOKEN counts, not round counts.
controller_state.context: context_pair_stats keyed by layer pair and max(0, context_length // 128); reset per request
controller_state.recent: Last 8 (accepted,drafted) rounds per layer; rate is ratio of sums, not EMA; reset per request
controller_state.combined_rate: Minimum of global, context, and recent conservative rates; see _contextual_rate_lcb for missing-stat defaults. Result clamped to [0,1].

Phi.implementation: _feedback_speculation_length computes midpoint with Python round((max_k+min_k)/2), then clips

controller_state.switch_cost: If previous layer exists and differs: score *= max(0,1-0.08).
controller_state.hysteresis: feedback cooldown 2; shallow score multiplier 0.90 while cooldown active; layer_switch_margin=0.0
controller_state.reset: reset_request_episode hybrid mode clears context, recent, streaks, cooldown, last-layer and episode action probes; preserves global pair and aggregate utility/probe state.
controller_state.aggregate_evaluation_initialization: Fresh create_april_controller per shard, or restore latest durable controller state on resume; no profiling controller injected (april_evaluation_source:980).
controller_state.preflight_state_effect: None: validate_full_preflight calls validate_shared_runtime, which checks shared objects/dtypes/attention/cache/version/EOS and performs no generation or controller updates (APRIL-owned april_preflight_source).
controller_state.checkpoint_policy: Historical harness atomic quartet/controller checkpoints; aggregate state saved. Public implementation has no equivalent resume qualification yet.
controller_state.full_initialization_and_numerics: april/controller_core.py constructor, RateStat, reset_request_episode; all factory knobs retained below

policy_semantics.acceptance_online_signal: accepted/drafted prefix feedback after each step

shallow_stopping.confidence_metric: softmax(unscaled shallow logits in logits dtype)[greedy token]
shallow_stopping.threshold_adjustment_rule: Recompute per round: base +step if bad_streak>0; then +0.5*step if cooldown>0; then -0.5*step if good_streak>=2; clamp [min,max]. Conditions independent, increments not multiplied by streak length.
shallow_stopping.exit_layer_dependence: Same threshold for all E; logits are from selected E
shallow_stopping.draft_position_dependence: Same threshold within round; test after appended token count reaches stop_after
shallow_stopping.exact_stopping_condition: Append greedy token; stop on EOS first; otherwise stop if threshold>0 and drafted>=stop_after and probability<threshold
shallow_stopping.eos_condition: EOS stops draft immediately, participates in target verification; committed EOS omitted from final output
shallow_stopping.recorded_adjustment_description: base threshold .55; +step on bad streak; +.5*step during cooldown; -.5*step for good streak>=2; clip to configured min/max. Low draft confidence stops after configured token threshold.

verification.commit: Target-approved prefix plus target correction/bonus; speculative cache beyond committed prefix discarded.
verification.recovery: Canonical FP16 checkpoint replay: initial prompt prefill if no checkpoint, Q1 catch-up through committed suffix and proposal; commit checkpoint advances through correction. See canonical_fp16_q1_target_recheck and advance_canonical_checkpoint.
verification.steps: Variable with checkpoint distance and proposal length; not universally a single target forward.
verification.ar_comparison_record: Public frozen measurement token hashes enable empirical comparison; no universal equality guarantee.

decoding.warmup: one target-model greedy 10-token warmup before measured pairs

statistics.sampling: Resample paired requests with replacement, keeping each workload count for overall; a single task for per-workload CI
statistics.moving_block_scope: block-size intervals are sensitivity analyses within one new A800 controller episode, not independent hardware replications
